chunks: And Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is not appropriate for a woman to uncover herself in front of a Jewish woman or a Christian woman, for they describe that to their husbands.

key_terms.تَنْكَشِفَ: to uncover herself or expose her body
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not appropriate or fitting

ai.seo_question: Is it appropriate for a woman to uncover herself in front of non-Muslim women according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that a woman should not uncover herself before Jewish or Christian women. The stated reason is that they may describe her appearance to their husbands, indicating a concern for modesty, privacy, and guarding personal boundaries.
